title: Malaysia Stock Market May See Renewed Support
text:
Malaysia Stock Market May See Renewed Support August 02, 2018, 07:31:00 Malaysia stock market on Thursday finally ended the eight-day winning streak in which it advanced almost 35 points or 2 percent. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now rests just beneath the 1,780-point plateau although it figures to bounce higher again KLCI finished modestly telecoms and financials, while the plantation stocks were mixed.
For the day, the index fell 10.18 points or 0.57 percent to finish at 1,778.13 after trading between 1,775.85 and 1,788.31. Volume was 2 billion shares worth 2 billion ringgit. There were 658 decliners and 246 gainers.
Among the actives, Genting Malaysia plummeted 2.70 percent, while IHH Healthcare plunged 1.99 percent, Digi.com tumbled 1.48 percent, Telekom Malaysia skidded 1.02 percent, Malaysia Airports Holdings jumped 0.84 percent, Dialog Group dropped 0.61 percent, Sime Darby advanced 0.40 percent, IOI Corporation shed 0.22 percent, Tenaga Nasional lost 0.13 percent, Maybank eased 0.10 percent and Kuala Lumpur Kepong, CIMB Group, PPB Group, Genting and Petronas Chemicals (AAPL) fueled
Closer to home, Malaysia will release June numbers for imports, exports and trade balance later today. In May, imports were worth 74.0 billion ringgit and exports were at 82.1 billion ringgit for a trade surplus of 8.1 billion ringgit. //www.rttnews.com/2922635/malaysia-stock-market-may-see-renewed-support.aspx )
